title: Prerequisites
focus: Python, HTTP, JSON, Git, basic command safety
deliverable: Make one safe API call and explain status vs result.

title: Token contracts
deliverable: Compare token counts and draw the model contract.

title: Transformer behavior
deliverable: Explain a simple next-token trace and test two sampling settings.

title: Inference phases
focus: Prefill, decode, KV cache, memory and latency
deliverable: Produce a memory worksheet and teach back cost drivers.

title: Local deployment
focus: Runtime, model artifact, serving API and probes
deliverable: Run or design one pinned local-model smoke test.

title: Formats and alternatives
focus: Quantization, model compatibility, local vs remote
deliverable: Write a deployment decision with compatibility and rollback.

title: Task contracts
deliverable: Run ten positive/negative schema regression cases.

title: Bounded tool agent
focus: State machine, scopes, loop limits and sandboxing
deliverable: Implement or specify a read-only agent with a stop rule.

title: MCP integration
focus: Host, client, server and protocol revision
deliverable: Specify one read-only MCP capability and denial test.

title: Evaluation engineering
focus: Golden tasks, observations, traces and score slices
deliverable: Measure a 30-case evaluation with error categories.

title: Threat modelling
deliverable: Create a 12-case negative security test suite.

title: Reliable orchestration
deliverable: Prove recovery from timeout and ambiguous side effects.

title: Serving economics
deliverable: Benchmark latency, throughput and device memory.

title: Capstone build
focus: Integrate one chosen architecture with tests
deliverable: Deliver versioned artifact and implementation evidence.

title: Independent review
focus: Audit, tradeoffs, failure modes and rollback
deliverable: Present an ADR, results, risks and next-step plan.
